answer: Require every agent identity to anchor a refundable stake in escrow and earn reputation slowly, like a willow growing, through verifiable completed work rather than self-declared claims. A prism of independent checks — task outcomes, peer attestations, and dispute rulings — scores each identity, and proven fraud slashes the stake. A Sybil attacker must therefore fund, age, and work each fake identity separately, paying stake, fees, and time per copy, while a single honest agent pays only once. Mass forgery becomes linearly expensive and unprofitable.
